translation:
In the condition of injury with retching (作嘔), if it is due to severe pain, or because attacking and reducing methods have injured the stomach, one should use Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯) with added dang gui (當歸), pinellia (半夏), and fresh ginger (生薑). If the liver is injured by anger, use Minor Bupleurum Decoction (小柴胡湯) with added gardenia (山梔) and poria (茯苓). If phlegm fire is exuberant, use Two Aged Decoction (二陳湯) with added ginger-fried coptis (姜炒黃連) and gardenia (山梔). If the stomach qi is deficient, use Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯) with added fresh ginger (生薑) and pinellia (半夏). If it is due to excessive loss of blood, use Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯) with added dang gui (當歸).
<ins>Four Gentlemen Decoction (四君子湯)</ins> and <ins>Supplementing the Middle and Benefiting Qi Decoction (補中益氣湯)</ins> (both are found under injury with bleeding, 傷損出血)
<ins>Minor Bupleurum Decoction (小柴胡湯)</ins> (the formula is found under diffusion and settling of stagnant blood, 瘀血泛注)
<ins>Two Aged Decoction (二陳湯)</ins> and <ins>Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯)</ins> (both are found under oppression and pain of the chest and abdomen, 胸腹痛悶)
